blog_summary: The blog post discusses an experiment where the author (Adrian Colyer) reviews multiple deep learning papers from Terry Taewoong Um's curated list of the top 100 most cited deep learning papers. Due to the volume of papers (26 reviewed in a week), the author condensed the reviews into shorter posts to cover more ground quickly. While the experiment successfully introduced a large body of research, the author found the pace unsustainable and the posts too lengthy for the usual format. The post reflects on the challenges of reviewing so many papers in a short time and hints at a return to the standard one-paper-per-day format. The author also expresses interest in diversifying content beyond deep learning in the future.
